title: A Confession for the Parish
author: Orsen Nakamura
blurb: Wendell Okonkwo, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
